exposure: Women with preterm preeclampsia receiving recombinant human antithrombin
Women with preterm preeclampsia receiving placebo
outcome: Days gained from randomization until delivery
cohort: 120 women with singleton pregnancy and early-onset or superimposed preeclampsia at 23 0/7 to 30 0/7 weeks' gestation
finding: The administration of recombinant human antithrombin in preterm preeclampsia neither prolonged pregnancy nor improved neonatal or maternal outcomes.
